title: Same Word Used as Different Parts of Speech (Ques. No. 51-79)
subtopic: Same Word Used as Different Parts of Speech (79 Marks)

questions.question: He has done <u>wrong</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
Adverb → verb modify করে
Noun → object হিসেবে বসতে পারে
এখানে wrong
✔ "done wrong" → verb কে modify করলে Adverb
✔ "done a wrong" অর্থে নিলে Noun
তাই দুইভাবেই সম্ভব।

questions.question: There is more talk <u>yet</u> to be told.[]
questions.explanation:
Adverb infinitive phrase (to be told) modify করতে পারে।
yet এখানে সময় বোঝাচ্ছে → তাই Adverb

questions.question: Yet there is time to mend the thing. Here 'yet' is -----.[]
questions.explanation: Sentence এর শুরুতে বসে পুরো clause modify করলে Adverb হয়।

questions.question: Which but is a preposition ?[]
options: It is but right to admit our faults.
What can we do but sit and wait ?
We tried hard, but did not succeed.
There is no one but likes him.
questions.explanation:
Preposition এর অর্থ হয় “except”
Structure: Preposition + Verb (bare form)
এখানে but = except

questions.question: Who's that ?' In the sentence that is a/an -----.[]
questions.explanation:
Pronoun noun এর বদলে বসে।
এখানে that = a person → তাই Pronoun

questions.question: Identify the correct sentence.[]
questions.explanation:
Linking verb (is/am/are) এর পরে Adjective বসে।
Structure: Subject + be verb + Adjective

questions.question: In which sentence is the word 'past' used as a preposition ?[]
options: Writing letters is a thing of the past.
I look back on the past without regret.
I called out to him as he ran past.
Tania was a wonderful singer, but she's past her prime.
questions.explanation:
Preposition এর পরে Noun phrase বসে।
past + her prime → তাই Preposition

questions.question: The sun went <u>down.</u> The underlined word is used here as a/an -----.[]
questions.explanation: Verb এর পরে বসে verb modify করলে Adverb।

questions.question: The children were playing outside. Here 'outside' is a -----.[]
questions.explanation:
play' verb, যাকে modify করছে 'outside', 
সুতরাং এটি adverb

questions.question: <u>Down</u> with the tyrant! Here 'down' is -----.[]
questions.explanation:
Imperative sentence এ অনেক সময় মূল verb বাদ পড়ে যায়, শুধু verb-এর অংশ ব্যবহার হয়। grammar বই অনুযায়ী
“down” সাধারণত adverb / adjective / preposition
কিন্তু এই ধরনের slogan expression এ এটা verb sense এ ব্যবহৃত হয়।
Exam point of view থেকে → Verb ধরতে হবে।

questions.question: She was found <u>unhurt</u>'. The underlined word is a/an -----.[]
questions.explanation: Verb কে modify করছে

questions.question: We work everyday except Friday. What part of speech is 'except' ?[]
questions.explanation:
Rule:
Preposition + Noun

questions.question:
If we finish our work <u>quickly,</u> we can go to the movies.
Today they have returned <u>home</u> earlier. 
Here the underlined word is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation: verb কে modify করে

questions.question: The time for sleep is past. The word 'past' is -----.[]
questions.explanation: Be verb এর পরে Adjective বসে

questions.question:
<u>Justice</u> should be done to the victim.
Here the underlined word is a/an -----.[]
questions.explanation: Modal verb এর আগে Subject থাকে → Subject সাধারণত Noun

questions.question: Which 'up' in the following sentences is adverb ?[]
options: Our system should be <u>up</u> by the noon.
We had our <u>ups</u> and downs of fortune.
questions.explanation: Verb + particle → Adverb

questions.question: Which of the following words can be used as a verb ?[]
questions.explanation: অনেক Adjective verb হিসেবেও হয়

questions.question: Shefali is taller than Rupali. / He is taller than I. Here 'than' is a -----.[]
questions.explanation:
Than clause introduce করে।
Clause + than + clause

questions.question: By the end of the day we were tired <u>but</u> happy. / He is poor <u>but</u> honest. The underlined word is a -----.[]
questions.explanation: Coordinating conjunction দুই clause যুক্ত করে

questions.question: In which sentence 'that' is used as a conjunction ?[]
options: The evil that men do remains after them.
He works hard that he may succeed.
questions.explanation: Subordinating conjunction clause যুক্ত করে

questions.question: English grammar is not too difficult to understand. Here 'English' is -----.[]
questions.explanation:
Rule:
Noun এর আগে বসে অন্য noun কে describe করলে Adjective

questions.question: Although she was tired, she went to work. In the sentence, 'Although' is a/an -------.[]
questions.explanation: Subordinating conjunction subordinate clause শুরু করে

questions.question: The sun is up'. Here 'up' is -----.[]
questions.explanation: verb কে modify করছে

questions.question: <u>Each</u> boy will get a prize'. Here 'Each' is a/an -----.[]
questions.explanation: Noun কে modify করছে

questions.question: We travelled by a <u>fast</u> train from Dhaka to Rajshahi.[]
questions.explanation: Adjective noun কে modify করে

questions.question: I went away after I had finished the work. Here 'after' is -----.[]
questions.explanation: After + clause → subordinating conjunction

questions.question: It is <u>no</u> joke. The underlined word in the sentence is a -----.[]
questions.explanation: Determiner হিসেবে noun modify করছে

questions.question: You are but a child. Here 'but' is used as -----.[]
questions.explanation: but = only → Adverb

questions.question: There are many coconut trees on ----- side of the road.[]
questions.explanation: Determiner + Noun
